laws.k: domestic-workers|MA|Law No. 19-12 on working and employment conditions of domestic workers
laws.t: Law No. 19-12 on working and employment conditions of domestic workers
laws.tp: Written contract, minimum age 18, weekly rest, leave, a minimum wage and labor inspector conciliation.
laws.s2: Kontrak tertulis, umur minimum 18 tahun, libur mingguan, cuti, upah minimum, dan mediasi oleh pengawas ketenagakerjaan.

coded.vl: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
coded.n: Dedicated statute with narrower terms than the Labour Code.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required, no language rule
coded.n: Written contract on a model form, deposited with the labor inspector.

coded.vl: A separate or lower minimum, or one set only by policy
coded.n: Minimum wage set at 60% of the general minimum (SMIG).

coded.vl: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
coded.n: 48 hours a week, above the Labour Code's 44.

coded.vl: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
coded.n: At least 24 consecutive hours each week.

coded.vl: Equal to or longer than for other workers

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
coded.n: Foreign workers need a contract approved by the labor ministry.

coded.vl: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
Included in the general social security system, including maternity
coded.n: Covered by the national social security fund (CNSS) since 2019.

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.vl: General criminal or civil law only
coded.n: Prohibits forced labor and violence; penalties in the law.
